title: Floating in Union
author: Bijayalaxmi Rath
text:
Eternal experience of eternity.
Silent communion of inner souls.
Tender touch of sensual sensation.
Fractions of melt and merge.
Possessive possessiveness an unavoidable possession.
Glint of a snowy mountain peak in a rising horizon.
Spine chilling cool in the season of autumn.
Forecast less soothing drizzle in the
scorching summer.
Connection of limitless longing in the
bondage of affection.
Existence in a voyage of hope.
Ultimate wish , floating in union,
draped in silky emotions.
Trip to oblivion with the blinking and
twinkling lamps of supreme kingdom.
